description: Get one charity's public details (name, legal name, location, short description, whether it issues tax receipts) and its giving page URL, by its slug (from find_charities). This tool only looks charities up and returns a link: it never takes a payment. The donor completes the gift themselves on the charity's giving page, and the charity issues the official tax receipt.

slug.description: The charity's slug, as returned by find_charities.

name: get_charity
title: Get a charity
